s0401.literal: On dingyou day, an ordu office was established.
s0401.idiomatic: On dingyou day an ordu office was established.

s0402.literal: On jihai day, Prince Kuokuochu requested that his allotted territories Ninghai, Deng, and Lai Prefectures form their own circuit; compared with other princes, annual levies would enter only Ninghai and not be sent to Yidu — the edict granted this.
s0402.idiomatic: On jihai day Prince Kuokuochu asked that his allotted Ninghai, Deng, and Lai prefectures be made a separate circuit; like other princes his annual levy would go only to Ninghai, not Yidu, and the court approved.

s0403.literal: On guimao day, wanhu Cui Song defeated Song relief troops for Xiangyang, beheaded their general Zhang Shun, and Cui Song and other officers and soldiers were rewarded with silver and silk in varying amounts.
s0403.idiomatic: On guimao day wanhu Cui Song defeated Song relief troops for Xiangyang, beheaded their general Zhang Shun, and Cui Song and his officers received silver and silk rewards in varying amounts.

s0404.literal: On yisi day, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
s0404.idiomatic: On yisi day the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

s0405.literal: On dingwei day, Yan Prefecture was changed to Yanjin County and, together with Yangwu, placed under Nanjing.
s0405.idiomatic: On dingwei day Yan Prefecture was made Yanjin County and, together with Yangwu, placed under Nanjing.

s0406.literal: On guichou day, famine in Liaodong and other routes was relieved.
s0406.idiomatic: On guichou day relief was issued for famine in Liaodong and other routes.

s0407.literal: In the ninth month, on jiazi day, Song Xiangyang general Zhang Gui brought paddle-wheel ships out of the city and fought downstream in a sudden attack; Aju, Ala Haiya, and others raised beacons and lit fires, illuminating the river like day; they led the fleet in battle for more than fifty li to Guimen Pass and captured Zhang Gui alive along with more than two thousand officers and soldiers.
s0407.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the ninth month Song Xiangyang general Zhang Gui led paddle-wheel ships out of the city in a downstream attack; Aju, Ala Haiya, and others raised beacons and fires until the river shone like day, then led the fleet fifty li in battle to Guimen Pass and captured Zhang Gui alive with more than two thousand officers and soldiers.

s0408.literal: On bingyin day, an edict to the Privy Council stated: "Among regular military households and registered kin and servant slaves in all routes, where adult males have sought exemptions through princes' influence to evade service, all are to be returned to the army; only those with refined craftsmanship may be reported by name."
s0408.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict to the Privy Council ordered that adult males among regular military households and registered kin and slaves in all routes who had used princely influence to evade service be returned to the army; only those with exceptional craft skills might be reported by name.

s0409.literal: On guiyou day, Associate Branch Secretariat Signatory Cui Bin sued Right Vice Director Ali for falsely reporting twenty thousand troops; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff and dismissed.
s0409.idiomatic: On guiyou day Cui Bin, associate signatory of the Henan branch secretariat, accused right vice director Ali of falsely reporting twenty thousand troops; an edict ordered Ali beaten with the staff and dismissed.

s0410.literal: On jiaxu day, the Naval Marshal's Headquarters was abolished.
s0410.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the naval marshal's headquarters was abolished.

s0411.literal: Eastern Chuan Marshal Li Ji and others raided Kai Prefecture territory, took Shiyang Stockade, and captured one Song general.
s0411.idiomatic: Eastern Chuan marshal Li Ji and others raided Kai Prefecture, took Shiyang Stockade, and captured a Song general.

s0412.literal: Army Commander Hela and others raided He Prefecture and the Qijiang River mouth, seizing fifty war vessels; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.
s0412.idiomatic: Army commander Hela and others raided He Prefecture and the Qijiang estuary, seizing fifty war vessels; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.

s0413.literal: On bingzi day, three thousand civilian laborers were sent to cut giant timber in Liaodong, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.
s0413.idiomatic: On bingzi day three thousand laborers were sent to cut giant timber in Liaodong, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.

s0414.literal: On wuyin day, the moon infringed upon the Woman asterism.
s0414.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon infringed upon the Woman asterism.

s0415.literal: Famine in Yidu Route was relieved.
s0415.idiomatic: Relief was issued for famine in Yidu.

s0416.literal: On the bingxu new moon in the tenth month of winter, the imperial son Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, granted Jingzhao as his allotment, and garrisoned troops at Liupan Mountain.
s0416.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the tenth month of winter Prince Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, given Jingzhao as his fief, and ordered to garrison Liupan Mountain.

s0417.literal: Envoys were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct the states of Banbu and Xindu.
s0417.idiomatic: Envoys were sent with an edict to instruct Banbu and Xindu.

s0418.literal: On renchen day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0418.idiomatic: On renchen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0419.literal: On guisi day, Zhao Bi was made Grand Councillor and Zhang Yi was made Vice Director of the Privy Council.
s0419.idiomatic: On guisi day Zhao Bi was made grand councillor and Zhang Yi vice director of the Privy Council.

s0420.literal: On yiwei day, the Hun River embankment was built.
s0420.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Hun River embankment was built.

s0421.literal: On wuxu day, Mars infringed upon Saturn.
s0421.idiomatic: On wuxu day Mars infringed upon Saturn.

s0422.literal: On jihai day, an edict permitted hunting from the seventh through the eleventh month and forbade it in the remaining months.
s0422.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict permitted hunting from the seventh through the eleventh month and forbade it in the remaining months.

s0423.literal: On guimao day, Wen Prefecture was established.
s0423.idiomatic: On guimao day Wen Prefecture was established.

s0424.literal: The Huitong Hostel was established for the first time.
s0424.idiomatic: The Huitong Hostel was established for the first time.

s0425.literal: On the yimao new moon of the eleventh month, an edict granted Goryeo the calendar of the tenth year of Zhiyuan.
s0425.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the eleventh month an edict granted Goryeo the calendar for the tenth year of Zhiyuan.

s0426.literal: On renxu day, six thousand civilian laborers were mobilized from Beijing to cut timber at Qianshan, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.
s0426.idiomatic: On renxu day six thousand Beijing laborers were sent to cut timber at Qianshan, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.

s0427.literal: Prince Zhibi Temür's newly built city was completed and granted the name Yongchang Prefecture.
s0427.idiomatic: Prince Zhibi Temür's newly built city was completed and named Yongchang Prefecture.

s0428.literal: On bingyin day, official debts owed by Cila Ot's ordu office were remitted.
s0428.idiomatic: On bingyin day official debts owed by Cila Ot's ordu office were remitted.

s0429.literal: On dingmao day, the moon infringed upon Bi.
s0429.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon infringed upon Bi.

s0431.literal: Unregistered troops were sent to raid Song territory.
s0431.idiomatic: Unregistered troops were sent to raid Song territory.

s0432.literal: On jisi day, an edict mobilized two thousand garrison-farming troops, two thousand Han troops, and six thousand Goryeo troops, augmenting them with two thousand Wuwei Guard troops, to campaign against Tamra.
s0432.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict mobilized two thousand garrison-farming troops, two thousand Han troops, six thousand Goryeo troops, and two thousand additional Wuwei Guard troops to campaign against Tamra.

s0433.literal: On xinwei day, the Gaoling Confucian Yang Gongyi was summoned but did not come.
s0433.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Gaoling Confucian Yang Gongyi was summoned but refused to come.

s0434.literal: On guiyou day, for the earlier merit in taking Fancheng's outer wall, wanhu Liu Shen and others were rewarded with gold and silver tally seals.
s0434.idiomatic: On guiyou day, for merit in taking Fancheng's outer wall, wanhu Liu Shen and others received gold and silver tally seals.

s0435.literal: On jimao day, the Central Secretariat's left and right bureaus were merged into one.
s0435.idiomatic: On jimao day the Central Secretariat's left and right bureaus were merged into one.

s0436.literal: Song Jinghu Military Commissioner Li Tingzhi wrote a letter and sent a Yongning monk bearing a gold seal and ivory tally to appoint Liu Zheng Military Commissioner of Lulong Army and enfeoff him as Prince of Yan Commandery.
s0436.idiomatic: Song Jinghu military commissioner Li Tingzhi wrote to Liu Zheng and sent a Yongning monk with a gold seal and ivory tally to appoint him military commissioner of the Lulong Army and enfeoff him as Prince of Yan Commandery.

s0437.literal: When the monk reached Yongning the affair was discovered and reported above; an edict ordered Zhang Yi and Yao Shu to conduct a joint inquiry.
s0437.idiomatic: When the monk reached Yongning the plot was discovered and reported; an edict ordered Zhang Yi and Yao Shu to conduct a joint inquiry.

s0438.literal: Liu Zheng had just arrived from the army and said: "The Song resent my campaigning at Xiangyang and wished to use this to kill me; I truly knew nothing of it."
s0438.idiomatic: Liu Zheng, just arrived from the army, said, "The Song resented my operations at Xiangyang and meant to use this to kill me; I truly knew nothing of it."

s0439.literal: An edict ordered Liu Zheng to write a reply; he was rewarded and sent back to the army, and the Yongning monk and his accomplices were put to death.
s0439.idiomatic: An edict ordered Liu Zheng to write a reply, rewarded him, and sent him back to the army; the Yongning monk and his accomplices were put to death.

s0440.literal: Branch Secretariat Associate Ali Haiya said: "Xiangyang has been besieged for a long time without falling; we should first attack Fancheng and cut off its support."
s0440.idiomatic: Branch secretariat associate Ali Haiya argued, "Xiangyang has been besieged long without falling; we should first attack Fancheng and cut off its relief."

s0442.literal: The Muslim Ismail invented a giant counterweight trebuchet and presented it; it required little force yet struck very far — an order sent it to the army before Xiangyang for use.
s0442.idiomatic: The Muslim engineer Ismail invented a counterweight trebuchet and presented it; it required little effort yet cast very far, and an order sent it to the Xiangyang front for use.

s0443.literal: On the yiyou new moon of the twelfth month, an edict ordered that in all routes the darughachi of prefectures, departments, and counties, while administering civilian chief officials, also administer the ordus of all armies.
s0443.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the twelfth month an edict ordered route darughachis of prefectures, departments, and counties, while overseeing civilian chiefs, also to administer all army ordus.

s0444.literal: On dinghai day, post stations at Suzhou and elsewhere were established.
s0444.idiomatic: On dinghai day post stations were established at Suzhou and elsewhere.

s0445.literal: More than fifty thousand households of Dongping Prefecture were restored as Dongping Route.
s0445.idiomatic: More than fifty thousand Dongping households were restored as Dongping Route.

s0446.literal: On xinchou day, Prince Hulachu registered fugitive civilians within the Goryeo border; Goryeo's darughachi reported the matter, and an edict stated that Goryeo's people were still not settled — the practice was forbidden and stopped.
s0446.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince Hulachu registered fugitive civilians in Goryeo; Goryeo's darughachi reported it, and an edict forbade the practice, saying Goryeo's people were still not settled.

s0447.literal: Song envoys discussing mutual trade were sent south to return home.
s0447.idiomatic: Song envoys discussing mutual trade were sent home to the south.

s0448.literal: On wuwu day, Prince of Beiping Nanmuhe was granted twelve thousand nine hundred ninety-one army horses and sixty-one thousand five hundred thirty-one sheep, and Prince Tachar was granted military silks and cloth.
s0448.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Nanmuhe of Beiping received twelve thousand nine hundred ninety-one army horses and sixty-one thousand five hundred thirty-one sheep, and Prince Tachar received military silks and cloth.

s0449.literal: On xinhai day, Song general Zan Wanshou came to attack Chengdu; Branch Secretariat Yan Zhongfan went out to fight but was defeated, withdrew to hold the inner city, and Associate Wang Shiying and seven others abandoned the city and fled.
s0449.idiomatic: On xinhai day Song general Zan Wanshou attacked Chengdu; branch secretariat Yan Zhongfan fought and lost, withdrew to the inner city, and associates Wang Shiying and seven others abandoned the city and fled.

s0450.literal: An edict stated that with the border city lost the guilt lay with the chief commander; though Wang Shiying had fled, he was exempted from punishment, and only envoys were sent to bind Yan Zhongfan and bring him to the capital.
s0450.idiomatic: An edict declared that with the border city lost the fault lay with the chief commander; though Wang Shiying had fled he was pardoned, and only Yan Zhongfan was bound and brought to the capital.

s0451.literal: On guichou day, the Arch Guard Office was promoted to Arch Guard Direct Command Headquarters.
s0451.idiomatic: On guichou day the Arch Guard Office was promoted to the Arch Guard Direct Command Headquarters.

s0452.literal: That year, registered households empire-wide numbered one million nine hundred fifty-five thousand eight hundred eighty.
s0452.idiomatic: That year registered households empire-wide numbered one million nine hundred fifty-five thousand eight hundred eighty.

s0453.literal: Empresses of former reigns and princes were granted gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.
s0453.idiomatic: Empresses of former reigns and princes received gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.

s0454.literal: Thirty-nine persons were sentenced to death.
s0454.idiomatic: Thirty-nine persons were sentenced to death.

s0455.literal: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built.
s0455.idiomatic: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built.
